# Audio to WAV converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/audio-wav/

Decode supported audio and export an uncompressed PCM WAV file. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Convert a short browser-readable audio recording into 16-bit PCM WAV.

## Limits and checks

The tool does not promise support for every codec. Files are processed in memory and are limited to keep smaller devices responsive.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
